map.由刀具耐用度选合理 vc 与每齿进给 fz。: Choose a reasonable vc and feed per tooth fz based on tool life.
map.：工件直径 d=50 mm、转速 n=1000 rpm：vc=π×50×1000: : With workpiece diameter d=50 mm and n=1000 rpm: vc=π×50×1000/1000=157.1 m/min. Carbide steel parts commonly use 150–250 m/min.
map.：每齿 fz=0.1 mm、齿数 z=4、n=1000：f=fz·z·n=0.1: : With feed per tooth fz=0.1 mm, tooth count z=4, and n=1000: f=fz·z·n=0.1×4×1000=400 mm/min. The feed per revolution is 0.4 mm.
map.切削速度习惯用 m/min（线速度），与直径 mm、转速 rpm 经 π·d·n: Cutting speed is customarily given in m/min (surface speed), converted from diameter in mm and spindle speed in rpm via π·d·n/1000.
map.进给越大效率越高？: Is a Larger Feed Always More Efficient?
map.是，但受刀具耐用度、表面粗糙度与机床刚度限制，过大易崩刃或振刀。: Yes, but it is limited by tool life, surface finish, and machine rigidity; too large a feed causes edge chipping or chatter.
